name: Scrubs
s: Old friends JD and Turk scrub in together for the first time in a long time, learning that medicine has changed; interns have changed; but their bromance has stood the test of time.

paragraphs.text: Scrubs (stylized as [scrubs]) is an American medical sitcom created by Bill Lawrence for ABC as a continuation of the 2001–2010 television series of the same name, and is developed by Aseem Batra and Tim Hobert. The series was officially announced by ABC in July 2025, following J.D. as he returns to Sacred Heart as its new Chief of Medicine years after the eighth season finale; the revival ignores the events of the ninth season of the original series, in which Sacred Heart Hospital was demolished. Zach Braff, Sarah Chalke and Donald Faison all star and return in their original series roles, alongside recurring returns and appearances by John C. McGinley and Judy Reyes.
The Scrubs revival premiered with its nine-episode first season on February 25, 2026. The ten-episode second season, which was announced that April, premiered on September 30, 2026.

The revival's first season received positive reviews from critics. On Rotten Tomatoes, the season has an approval rating of 90% based on 50 reviews with an average score of 7.4/10. The website's critics consensus reads, "Scrubs revives and revamps its signature laughs and cast to deliver another fan-favorite run of medical gags, heartfelt dramedy, and instant fun." On Metacritic, it has a score of 73 out of 100 based on 27 reviews, signifying "generally favorable" reviews.
The revival continued to receive positive reviews into its second season. On Rotten Tomatoes, it has an approval rating of 100% based on 6 reviews with an average score of 7.7/10.
